nvtiffGetProperty.doc:
Gets the library’s property values.

This function retrieves version information about the nvTIFF library. The `libraryPropertyType` enum is defined in CUDA’s `library_types.h` header.

type.doc: The property to retrieve. Valid values are.

value.doc: Pointer to receive the numeric value of the requested property.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvtiff/apireference.html#nvtiff_8h_1a6bb6a8150db026477c1bb83fdc7b8801).

An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvtiff/apireference.html#nvtiff_8h_1a6bb6a8150db026477c1bb83fdc7b8801).

nvtiffDecoderCreate.signature: nvtiffStatus_t nvtiffDecoderCreate(nvtiffDecoder_t * decoder, nvtiffDeviceAllocator_t * device_allocator, nvtiffPinnedAllocator_t * pinned_allocator, cudaStream_t stream)

device_allocator.doc: User-provided device memory allocator. If `NULL`, the library uses `cudaMalloc` / `cudaFree`.

pinned_allocator.doc: User-provided pinned memory allocator. If `NULL`, the library uses `cudaHostAlloc` / `cudaFreeHost`.

stream.doc: CUDA stream for asynchronous API calls.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvtiff/apireference.html#nvtiff_8h_1a6bb6a8150db026477c1bb83fdc7b8801).

nvtiffDecoderCreateSimple.doc: Creates an instance of the decoder handle with default memory allocators.

stream.doc: CUDA stream for asynchronous API calls.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvtiff/apireference.html#nvtiff_8h_1a6bb6a8150db026477c1bb83fdc7b8801).

stream.doc: CUDA stream for asynchronous API calls.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvtiff/apireference.html#nvtiff_8h_1a6bb6a8150db026477c1bb83fdc7b8801).

nvtiffEncoderCreate.doc: Creates and initializes a TIFF encoder instance.
nvtiffEncoderCreate.signature: nvtiffStatus_t nvtiffEncoderCreate(nvtiffEncoder_t * encoder, nvtiffDeviceAllocator_t * device_allocator, nvtiffPinnedAllocator_t * pinned_allocator, cudaStream_t stream)

device_allocator.doc: Custom device memory allocator (can be `NULL` to use `cudaMalloc()` / `cudaFree()`).

pinned_allocator.doc: Custom pinned memory allocator (can be `NULL` to use `cudaHostAlloc()` / `cudaFreeHost()`).

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvtiff/apireference.html#nvtiff_8h_1a6bb6a8150db026477c1bb83fdc7b8801).

nvtiffEncoderDestroy.doc: Destroys a TIFF encoder instance and frees associated resources.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvtiff/apireference.html#nvtiff_8h_1a6bb6a8150db026477c1bb83fdc7b8801).

nvtiffEncodeParamsCreate.doc: Creates and initializes encode parameters object.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvtiff/apireference.html#nvtiff_8h_1a6bb6a8150db026477c1bb83fdc7b8801).

nvtiffStreamParseFromFile.doc: Parses a TIFF file and stores the metadata in the stream handle.
nvtiffStreamParseFromFile.signature: nvtiffStatus_t nvtiffStreamParseFromFile(const char * fname, nvtiffStream_t tiff_stream)

tiff_stream.doc: TIFF stream handle to be initialized.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvtiff/apireference.html#nvtiff_8h_1a6bb6a8150db026477c1bb83fdc7b8801).

nvtiffStreamParse.doc:
Parses a TIFF file from host memory and stores the metadata.

For best decode performance, the host buffer should be page-locked (pinned) memory. This can be allocated with `cudaHostAlloc`.
nvtiffStreamParse.signature: nvtiffStatus_t nvtiffStreamParse(const uint8_t * buffer, size_t buffer_size, nvtiffStream_t tiff_stream)

buffer_size.doc: Size of the buffer in bytes.

tiff_stream.doc: TIFF stream handle to be initialized.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvtiff/apireference.html#nvtiff_8h_1a6bb6a8150db026477c1bb83fdc7b8801).

nvtiffStreamParseFromFileEx.doc:
Extended version of `nvtiffStreamParseFromFile()` with pagination support.

Supports parsing from a specific bitstream offset and limiting the number of images parsed. This is useful for parsing large multi-image TIFFs incrementally.

If `bitstream_offset` is zero, parsing starts at the first IFD specified in the TIFF header. If `limit_images` is zero, all images in the IFD chain are parsed.
nvtiffStreamParseFromFileEx.signature: nvtiffStatus_t nvtiffStreamParseFromFileEx(const char * fname, nvtiffStream_t tiff_stream, size_t bitstream_offset, uint32_t limit_images, size_t * next_bitstream_offset)

tiff_stream.doc: TIFF stream handle to be initialized.

bitstream_offset.doc: Bitstream offset of the IFD to start parsing from (0 = beginning).

limit_images.doc: Maximum number of images to parse (0 = no limit).

next_bitstream_offset.doc: If non-null, receives the offset of the next IFD (0 if end of chain).

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvtiff/apireference.html#nvtiff_8h_1a6bb6a8150db026477c1bb83fdc7b8801).

nvtiffStreamParseEx.doc:
Extended version of `nvtiffStreamParse()` with pagination support.

Supports parsing from a specific bitstream offset and limiting the number of images parsed. This is useful for parsing large multi-image TIFFs from memory incrementally.
nvtiffStreamParseEx.signature: nvtiffStatus_t nvtiffStreamParseEx(const uint8_t * buffer, size_t buffer_size, nvtiffStream_t tiff_stream, size_t bitstream_offset, uint32_t limit_images, size_t * next_bitstream_offset)

buffer_size.doc: Size of the buffer in bytes.

tiff_stream.doc: TIFF stream handle to be initialized.

bitstream_offset.doc: Bitstream offset of the IFD to start parsing from (0 = beginning).

limit_images.doc: Maximum number of images to parse (0 = no limit).

next_bitstream_offset.doc: If non-null, receives the offset of the next IFD (0 if end of chain).

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvtiff/apireference.html#nvtiff_8h_1a6bb6a8150db026477c1bb83fdc7b8801).

nvtiffStreamParseFromParentStream.doc:
Parses a new stream from a specified bitstream offset within an existing TIFF stream.

This can be used to parse SubIFDs and other custom IFD chains. The new stream shares the same base resource (file or memory buffer) as the parent stream. The resource is only released when all streams referencing it have been destroyed.

The `offset_stream` parameter can be the same as `parent_stream`, in which case the source stream will be replaced with the target stream.
nvtiffStreamParseFromParentStream.signature: nvtiffStatus_t nvtiffStreamParseFromParentStream(nvtiffStream_t parent_stream, nvtiffStream_t offset_stream, size_t bitstream_offset, uint32_t limit_images, size_t * next_bitstream_offset)

offset_stream.doc: Stream handle to be initialized from the specified offset.

bitstream_offset.doc: Bitstream offset of the IFD to parse relative to the file beginning.

limit_images.doc: Maximum number of images to parse along the IFD chain (0 = no limit).

next_bitstream_offset.doc: If non-null, receives the offset of the next IFD (0 if end of chain).

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvtiff/apireference.html#nvtiff_8h_1a6bb6a8150db026477c1bb83fdc7b8801).

nvtiffStreamGetBitstreamOffset.doc:
Retrieves the bitstream offset of a given IFD within the TIFF file.

Each image’s bitstream offset serves as a unique identifier, which is helpful for dealing with complex TIFF structures involving SubIFDs.
nvtiffStreamGetBitstreamOffset.signature: nvtiffStatus_t nvtiffStreamGetBitstreamOffset(nvtiffStream_t tiff_stream, uint32_t image_id, size_t * offset)

offset.doc: Pointer to receive the file offset where the image’s IFD begins.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvtiff/apireference.html#nvtiff_8h_1a6bb6a8150db026477c1bb83fdc7b8801).

nvtiffStreamPrint.doc: Prints the TIFF file metadata to standard output.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvtiff/apireference.html#nvtiff_8h_1a6bb6a8150db026477c1bb83fdc7b8801).

nvtiffStreamGetNumImages.doc: Retrieves the number of images stored in a TIFF file.

num_images.doc: Pointer to receive the number of images.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvtiff/apireference.html#nvtiff_8h_1a6bb6a8150db026477c1bb83fdc7b8801).

nvtiffStreamGetImageInfo.doc: Retrieves the image information for a given image in a TIFF file.
nvtiffStreamGetImageInfo.signature: nvtiffStatus_t nvtiffStreamGetImageInfo(nvtiffStream_t tiff_stream, uint32_t image_id, nvtiffImageInfo_t * image_info)

image_info.doc: Pointer to [nvtiffImageInfo_t](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvtiff/apireference.html#structnvtiffImageInfo__t) structure to receive the image information.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvtiff/apireference.html#nvtiff_8h_1a6bb6a8150db026477c1bb83fdc7b8801).

nvtiffStreamGetImageGeometry.doc:
Retrieves image geometry information.

Geometry includes information whether the images use strips or tiles and their corresponding dimensions.
nvtiffStreamGetImageGeometry.signature: nvtiffStatus_t nvtiffStreamGetImageGeometry(nvtiffStream_t tiff_stream, uint32_t image_id, nvtiffImageGeometry_t * geometry)

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvtiff/apireference.html#nvtiff_8h_1a6bb6a8150db026477c1bb83fdc7b8801).

nvtiffStreamGetTagInfo.doc:
Retrieves TIFF tag information.

Retrieves tag type, size per element, and count for a specific tag in an image.
nvtiffStreamGetTagInfo.signature: nvtiffStatus_t nvtiffStreamGetTagInfo(nvtiffStream_t tiff_stream, uint32_t image_id, nvtiffTag_t tiff_tag, nvtiffTagDataType_t * tag_type, uint32_t * size, uint32_t * count)

tag_type.doc: Pointer to receive the datatype of the tag.

size.doc: Pointer to receive the size of individual values in the tag.

count.doc: Pointer to receive the number of values in the tag.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvtiff/apireference.html#nvtiff_8h_1a6bb6a8150db026477c1bb83fdc7b8801).

nvtiffStreamGetTagValue.doc: Retrieves the values stored in a TIFF tag.
nvtiffStreamGetTagValue.signature: nvtiffStatus_t nvtiffStreamGetTagValue(nvtiffStream_t tiff_stream, uint32_t image_id, nvtiffTag_t tiff_tag, void * tag_value, uint32_t count)

tag_value.doc: Pointer to buffer to receive the tag values.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvtiff/apireference.html#nvtiff_8h_1a6bb6a8150db026477c1bb83fdc7b8801).

nvtiffStreamGetTagInfoGeneric.doc:
Retrieves TIFF tag information using a generic tag ID.

Retrieves tag type, size per element, and count for any TIFF tag (not just nvtiffTag_t values). If the tag is not found, returns [`nvtiffStatus_t::NVTIFF_STATUS_TAG_NOT_FOUND`].
nvtiffStreamGetTagInfoGeneric.signature: nvtiffStatus_t nvtiffStreamGetTagInfoGeneric(nvtiffStream_t tiff_stream, uint32_t image_id, uint16_t tiff_tag, nvtiffTagDataType_t * tag_type, uint32_t * size, uint32_t * count)

tiff_tag.doc: TIFF tag ID (any valid TIFF tag number).

tag_type.doc: Pointer to receive the datatype of the tag.

size.doc: Pointer to receive the size per element. When tag type is [`nvtiffTagDataType_t::NVTIFF_TAG_TYPE_ASCII`], the string is NULL terminated.

count.doc: Pointer to receive the number of elements.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvtiff/apireference.html#nvtiff_8h_1a6bb6a8150db026477c1bb83fdc7b8801).

nvtiffStreamGetTagValueGeneric.doc:
Retrieves the values stored in a TIFF tag using a generic tag ID.

If the tag is not found, returns [`nvtiffStatus_t::NVTIFF_STATUS_TAG_NOT_FOUND`].
nvtiffStreamGetTagValueGeneric.signature: nvtiffStatus_t nvtiffStreamGetTagValueGeneric(nvtiffStream_t tiff_stream, uint32_t image_id, uint16_t tiff_tag, void * tag_value, uint32_t count)

tiff_tag.doc: TIFF tag ID (any valid TIFF tag number).

tag_value.doc: Output buffer to receive the tag value.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvtiff/apireference.html#nvtiff_8h_1a6bb6a8150db026477c1bb83fdc7b8801).

nvtiffStreamGetNumberOfTags.doc:
Enumerates all TIFF tags present in a specific image.

Use the two-call pattern: first call with tags=`NULL` to get the count, then allocate a buffer and call again to retrieve the tag IDs.
nvtiffStreamGetNumberOfTags.signature: nvtiffStatus_t nvtiffStreamGetNumberOfTags(nvtiffStream_t tiff_stream, uint32_t image_id, uint16_t * tags, uint32_t * num_tags)

tags.doc: Pointer to buffer for storing tag IDs (can be `NULL` to get count only).

num_tags.doc: Pointer to receive the number of tags.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvtiff/apireference.html#nvtiff_8h_1a6bb6a8150db026477c1bb83fdc7b8801).

nvtiffStreamHasTag.doc:
Checks whether a specific tag exists in an image.

This is useful for quickly determining tag presence without enumerating all tags.
nvtiffStreamHasTag.signature: nvtiffStatus_t nvtiffStreamHasTag(nvtiffStream_t tiff_stream, uint32_t image_id, uint16_t tag, int * has_tag)

has_tag.doc: Set to 1 if tag exists, 0 if not.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvtiff/apireference.html#nvtiff_8h_1a6bb6a8150db026477c1bb83fdc7b8801).

nvtiffStreamGetGeoKeyInfo.doc:
Retrieves information about a GeoTIFF key.

This information is useful for retrieving the values associated with the geo key.
nvtiffStreamGetGeoKeyInfo.signature: nvtiffStatus_t nvtiffStreamGetGeoKeyInfo(nvtiffStream_t tiff_stream, nvtiffGeoKey_t key, uint32_t * size, uint32_t * count, nvtiffGeoKeyDataType_t * type)

size.doc: Pointer to receive the size of each value (in bytes).

count.doc: Pointer to receive the number of values stored in key.

type.doc: Pointer to receive the datatype of values stored in key.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvtiff/apireference.html#nvtiff_8h_1a6bb6a8150db026477c1bb83fdc7b8801).

nvtiffStreamGetNumberOfGeoKeys.doc:
Retrieves the list of GeoTIFF keys present in a TIFF file and their count.

Use the two-call pattern: first call with key=`NULL` to get the count, then allocate a buffer and call again to retrieve the key IDs.
nvtiffStreamGetNumberOfGeoKeys.signature: nvtiffStatus_t nvtiffStreamGetNumberOfGeoKeys(nvtiffStream_t tiff_stream, nvtiffGeoKey_t * key, uint32_t * num_keys)

key.doc: Pointer to buffer for storing geokey IDs (can be `NULL` to get count only).

num_keys.doc: Pointer to receive the number of geokeys.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvtiff/apireference.html#nvtiff_8h_1a6bb6a8150db026477c1bb83fdc7b8801).

nvtiffStreamGetGeoKey.doc: Retrieves the values associated with a given GeoTIFF key.
nvtiffStreamGetGeoKey.signature: nvtiffStatus_t nvtiffStreamGetGeoKey(nvtiffStream_t tiff_stream, nvtiffGeoKey_t key, void * val, uint32_t count)

val.doc: Pointer to buffer to receive the key values.

count.doc: Number of values to copy. For [`nvtiffGeoKeyDataType_t::NVTIFF_GEOKEY_TYPE_ASCII`] this is ignored. For [`nvtiffGeoKeyDataType_t::NVTIFF_GEOKEY_TYPE_SHORT`], `count=1` is implied.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvtiff/apireference.html#nvtiff_8h_1a6bb6a8150db026477c1bb83fdc7b8801).

nvtiffStreamGetGeoKeyASCII.doc: Retrieves ASCII values associated with a GeoTIFF key.
nvtiffStreamGetGeoKeyASCII.signature: nvtiffStatus_t nvtiffStreamGetGeoKeyASCII(nvtiffStream_t tiff_stream, nvtiffGeoKey_t key, char * str, uint32_t max_len)

str.doc: Pointer to buffer to receive the ASCII string.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvtiff/apireference.html#nvtiff_8h_1a6bb6a8150db026477c1bb83fdc7b8801).

nvtiffStreamGetGeoKeySHORT.doc: Retrieves SHORT values associated with a GeoTIFF key.
nvtiffStreamGetGeoKeySHORT.signature: nvtiffStatus_t nvtiffStreamGetGeoKeySHORT(nvtiffStream_t tiff_stream, nvtiffGeoKey_t key, unsigned short * val, uint32_t index, uint32_t count)

val.doc: Pointer to buffer to receive the SHORT values.

index.doc: Index of the starting value to copy.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvtiff/apireference.html#nvtiff_8h_1a6bb6a8150db026477c1bb83fdc7b8801).

nvtiffStreamGetGeoKeyDOUBLE.doc: Retrieves DOUBLE values associated with a GeoTIFF key.
nvtiffStreamGetGeoKeyDOUBLE.signature: nvtiffStatus_t nvtiffStreamGetGeoKeyDOUBLE(nvtiffStream_t tiff_stream, nvtiffGeoKey_t key, double * val, uint32_t index, uint32_t count)

val.doc: Pointer to buffer to receive the DOUBLE values.

index.doc: Index of the starting value to copy.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvtiff/apireference.html#nvtiff_8h_1a6bb6a8150db026477c1bb83fdc7b8801).

nvtiffDecodeRange.doc:
Decodes a range of images from a TIFF file.

Decodes images in the range `[sub_file_start, sub_file_start + sub_file_num)`. When the photometric interpretation is [`nvtiffPhotometricInt_t::NVTIFF_PHOTOMETRIC_PALETTE`] or [`nvtiffPhotometricInt_t::NVTIFF_PHOTOMETRIC_YCBCR`], the decode output will be converted to RGB. For images with multiple samples, the decode output will always be in planar contiguous format.
nvtiffDecodeRange.signature: nvtiffStatus_t nvtiffDecodeRange(nvtiffStream_t tiff_stream, nvtiffDecoder_t decoder, unsigned int sub_file_start, unsigned int sub_file_num, unsigned char * * image_out, cudaStream_t stream)

tiff_stream.doc: TIFF stream handle containing the parsed file.

sub_file_start.doc: Index of the first image to decode, in the range `[0, num_images)`.

sub_file_num.doc: Number of images to decode starting from `sub_file_start`.

image_out.doc: Host array of pointers to device buffers. Each buffer size should be `image_height * DivUp(image_width * bits_per_pixel, 8)`. For palette mode images, buffer size should be `image_width * image_height * 6`.

stream.doc: CUDA stream for GPU work submission.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvtiff/apireference.html#nvtiff_8h_1a6bb6a8150db026477c1bb83fdc7b8801).

nvtiffDecode.doc:
Decodes all images from a TIFF file.

Decodes all image data on the GPU. Each image is copied into the respective buffer pointed to by `image_out`. This function is fully asynchronous. When the photometric interpretation is [`nvtiffPhotometricInt_t::NVTIFF_PHOTOMETRIC_PALETTE`] or [`nvtiffPhotometricInt_t::NVTIFF_PHOTOMETRIC_YCBCR`], the decode output will be converted to RGB. For images with multiple samples, the decode output will always be in planar contiguous format.
nvtiffDecode.signature: nvtiffStatus_t nvtiffDecode(nvtiffStream_t tiff_stream, nvtiffDecoder_t decoder, unsigned char * * image_out, cudaStream_t stream)

tiff_stream.doc: TIFF stream handle containing the parsed file.

image_out.doc: Host array (of size `num_images`) of pointers to device buffers. Each buffer size should be `image_height * DivUp(image_width * bits_per_pixel, 8)`. For palette mode images, buffer size should be `image_width * image_height * 6`.

stream.doc: CUDA stream for GPU work submission.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvtiff/apireference.html#nvtiff_8h_1a6bb6a8150db026477c1bb83fdc7b8801).

nvtiffDecodeImage.doc:
Decodes a single image with additional output control.

Decodes a single image on the GPU. The function is asynchronous with respect to the host. Additional control of the decode output is possible using `nvtiffDecodeParams_t`.
nvtiffDecodeImage.signature: nvtiffStatus_t nvtiffDecodeImage(nvtiffStream_t tiff_stream, nvtiffDecoder_t decoder, nvtiffDecodeParams_t params, uint32_t image_id, void * image_out_d, cudaStream_t stream)

tiff_stream.doc: TIFF stream handle containing the parsed file.

params.doc: Decode parameters for controlling output (ROI, output format).

image_id.doc: Image index within the TIFF file.

image_out_d.doc: Device buffer for decoded output. See `nvtiffDecodeParamsSetOutputFormat()` for size requirements.

stream.doc: CUDA stream for GPU work submission.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvtiff/apireference.html#nvtiff_8h_1a6bb6a8150db026477c1bb83fdc7b8801).

nvtiffDecodeImageEx.doc:
Decodes a single image with extended output support.

Decodes a single image on the GPU with extended output buffer control via `nvtiffImage_t`. The function is asynchronous with respect to the host.
nvtiffDecodeImageEx.signature: nvtiffStatus_t nvtiffDecodeImageEx(nvtiffStream_t tiff_stream, nvtiffDecoder_t decoder, nvtiffDecodeParams_t params, uint32_t image_id, nvtiffImage_t * image_out, cudaStream_t stream)

tiff_stream.doc: TIFF stream handle containing the parsed file.

params.doc: Decode parameters for controlling output (ROI, output format).

image_id.doc: Image index within the TIFF file.

image_out.doc: Output image structure. Only one output plane is currently supported. The pitch must be aligned to the size of the sample type.

stream.doc: CUDA stream for GPU work submission.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvtiff/apireference.html#nvtiff_8h_1a6bb6a8150db026477c1bb83fdc7b8801).

nvtiffDecodeCheckSupported.doc:
Checks whether an image can be decoded by nvTIFF.

Returns [`nvtiffStatus_t::NVTIFF_STATUS_SUCCESS`] if the image is supported.
nvtiffDecodeCheckSupported.signature: nvtiffStatus_t nvtiffDecodeCheckSupported(nvtiffStream_t tiff_stream, nvtiffDecoder_t decoder, nvtiffDecodeParams_t params, uint32_t image_id)

tiff_stream.doc: TIFF stream handle containing the parsed file.

image_id.doc: Image index within the TIFF file.

return_value.doc: [`nvtiffStatus_t::NVTIFF_STATUS_SUCCESS`] if supported, otherwise an error code as specified in [API](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvtiff/apireference.html#nvtiff_8h_1a6bb6a8150db026477c1bb83fdc7b8801)Return Status Codes”.

nvtiffDecodeParamsSetOutputFormat.doc:
Sets the decode output format.

The default value is [`nvtiffOutputFormat_t::NVTIFF_OUTPUT_UNCHANGED_I`].

**Buffer size and pitch requirements:**

When [`nvtiffOutputFormat_t::NVTIFF_OUTPUT_UNCHANGED_I`] is used:

* Buffer size: `image_height * DivUp(image_width * bits_per_pixel, 8)`
* Pitch must be aligned to `DivUp(bits_per_sample[0], 8)` bytes.
* Default pitch (if not specified): `DivUp(image_width * bits_per_pixel, 8)`

When [`nvtiffOutputFormat_t::NVTIFF_OUTPUT_RGB_I_UINT8`] is used:

* Buffer size: `image_width * image_height * 3`
* Pitch must be aligned to 1 byte.

When [`nvtiffOutputFormat_t::NVTIFF_OUTPUT_RGB_I_UINT16`] is used:

* Buffer size: `image_width * image_height * 6`
* Pitch must be aligned to 2 bytes.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvtiff/apireference.html#nvtiff_8h_1a6bb6a8150db026477c1bb83fdc7b8801).

nvtiffDecodeParamsSetROI.doc:
Sets the region of interest for decoding.

The entire image is decoded by default.

Constraints:

* `offset_x` and `offset_y` must be non-negative and cannot exceed image dimensions.
* `offset_x + roi_width` and `offset_y + roi_height` cannot exceed image dimensions.
* When image bitdepth is 1, `offset_x` and `roi_width` must be multiples of 8.
nvtiffDecodeParamsSetROI.signature: nvtiffStatus_t nvtiffDecodeParamsSetROI(nvtiffDecodeParams_t decode_params, int32_t offset_x, int32_t offset_y, int32_t roi_width, int32_t roi_height)

roi_width.doc: Width of the region of interest.

roi_height.doc: Height of the region of interest.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvtiff/apireference.html#nvtiff_8h_1a6bb6a8150db026477c1bb83fdc7b8801).

nvtiffEncode.doc:
Performs asynchronous TIFF encoding of one or more images.

Parameters must be set using `nvtiffEncodeParamsSetImageInfo()` and `nvtiffEncodeParamsSetInputs()` before calling this function. If the provided compression method (LZW by default) results in a bitstream larger than the raw input image data, compression is automatically disabled.
nvtiffEncode.signature: nvtiffStatus_t nvtiffEncode(nvtiffEncoder_t encoder, nvtiffEncodeParams_t * params, uint32_t num_params, cudaStream_t stream)

num_params.doc: Number of encode parameters (must be 1 for now).

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvtiff/apireference.html#nvtiff_8h_1a6bb6a8150db026477c1bb83fdc7b8801).

nvtiffEncodeFinalize.doc:
Finalizes asynchronous TIFF encoding operation started by `nvtiffEncode()`.

This function must be called before the encoded bitstream can be written with `nvtiffWriteTiffBuffer()` or `nvtiffWriteTiffFile()`.
nvtiffEncodeFinalize.signature: nvtiffStatus_t nvtiffEncodeFinalize(nvtiffEncoder_t encoder, nvtiffEncodeParams_t * params, uint32_t num_params, cudaStream_t stream)

num_params.doc: Number of encode parameters (must be 1 for now).

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvtiff/apireference.html#nvtiff_8h_1a6bb6a8150db026477c1bb83fdc7b8801).

nvtiffGetBitstreamSize.doc:
Calculates the size of TIFF metadata and/or compressed bitstream.

Either `metadata_size` or `bitstream_size` can be `NULL` to skip that calculation. `metadata_size` can be calculated before calling `nvtiffEncode()`, but `bitstream_size` can only be calculated after `nvtiffEncodeFinalize()` is called.
nvtiffGetBitstreamSize.signature: nvtiffStatus_t nvtiffGetBitstreamSize(nvtiffEncoder_t encoder, nvtiffEncodeParams_t * params, uint32_t num_params, size_t * metadata_size, size_t * bitstream_size)

num_params.doc: Number of encode parameters (must be 1 for now).

metadata_size.doc: Size of TIFF metadata in bytes (can be NULL).

bitstream_size.doc: Size of compressed data in bytes (can be NULL).

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvtiff/apireference.html#nvtiff_8h_1a6bb6a8150db026477c1bb83fdc7b8801).

nvtiffWriteTiffBuffer.doc:
Writes complete TIFF data including metadata to a host memory buffer.

This function performs stream synchronization internally to ensure the bitstream is ready.
nvtiffWriteTiffBuffer.signature: nvtiffStatus_t nvtiffWriteTiffBuffer(nvtiffEncoder_t encoder, nvtiffEncodeParams_t * params, uint32_t num_params, uint8_t * buffer, size_t size, cudaStream_t stream)

num_params.doc: Number of encode parameters (must be 1 for now).

buffer.doc: Buffer to write TIFF data to.

size.doc: Size of output buffer in bytes.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvtiff/apireference.html#nvtiff_8h_1a6bb6a8150db026477c1bb83fdc7b8801).

nvtiffWriteTiffFile.doc:
Writes complete TIFF data including metadata to a file.

This function performs stream synchronization internally to ensure the bitstream is ready.
nvtiffWriteTiffFile.signature: nvtiffStatus_t nvtiffWriteTiffFile(nvtiffEncoder_t encoder, nvtiffEncodeParams_t * params, uint32_t num_params, const char * fname, cudaStream_t stream)

num_params.doc: Number of encode parameters (must be 1 for now).

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvtiff/apireference.html#nvtiff_8h_1a6bb6a8150db026477c1bb83fdc7b8801).

nvtiffEncodeParamsSetTiffVariant.doc:
Sets the TIFF variant (regular or BigTIFF) for encoding.

This API is optional; by default, regular TIFF is used.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvtiff/apireference.html#nvtiff_8h_1a6bb6a8150db026477c1bb83fdc7b8801).

nvtiffEncodeParamsSetImageInfo.doc:
Sets image information for encoding.

Required fields: `image_width`, `image_height`, `samples_per_pixel`, `bits_per_sample`, and `sample_format` (for each sample in a pixel).

Constraints:

* `samples_per_pixel` must be either 1 or 3.
* `photometric_int` must be [`nvtiffPhotometricInt_t::NVTIFF_PHOTOMETRIC_RGB`] (if `samples_per_pixel` is 3) or [`nvtiffPhotometricInt_t::NVTIFF_PHOTOMETRIC_MINISBLACK`] (if `samples_per_pixel` is 1). [`nvtiffPhotometricInt_t::NVTIFF_PHOTOMETRIC_UNKNOWN`] is auto-set.
* `sample_format` must be [`nvtiffSampleFormat_t::NVTIFF_SAMPLEFORMAT_UNKNOWN`], [`nvtiffSampleFormat_t::NVTIFF_SAMPLEFORMAT_UINT`], or [`nvtiffSampleFormat_t::NVTIFF_SAMPLEFORMAT_IEEEFP`].
* `planar_config` must be [`nvtiffPlanarConfig_t::NVTIFF_PLANARCONFIG_CONTIG`].
* `compression` must be [`nvtiffCompression_t::NVTIFF_COMPRESSION_LZW`] or [`nvtiffCompression_t::NVTIFF_COMPRESSION_NONE`].

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvtiff/apireference.html#nvtiff_8h_1a6bb6a8150db026477c1bb83fdc7b8801).

nvtiffEncodeParamsSetImageGeometry.doc:
Sets strip size for encoding.

This is optional; by default, strip size will be set to 8 KB. Only the `strile_height` field (number of rows per strip) needs to be set, as only stripes (not tiles) are currently supported.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvtiff/apireference.html#nvtiff_8h_1a6bb6a8150db026477c1bb83fdc7b8801).

nvtiffEncodeParamsSetInputs.doc: Sets input image pointers for encoding.

images_d.doc: Host array of size `num_images` of pointers to device buffers.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvtiff/apireference.html#nvtiff_8h_1a6bb6a8150db026477c1bb83fdc7b8801).

nvtiffEncodeParamsSetGeoKey.doc: Sets a GeoTIFF key with arbitrary type and value.
nvtiffEncodeParamsSetGeoKey.signature: nvtiffStatus_t nvtiffEncodeParamsSetGeoKey(nvtiffEncodeParams_t params, nvtiffGeoKey_t key, nvtiffGeoKeyDataType_t type, void * value, uint32_t value_size, uint32_t count)

nvtiffStatus_t.doc: Return status codes for nvTIFF APIs.

NVTIFF_STATUS_SUCCESS.doc: The API call finished successfully. Note that many calls are asynchronous and some errors may only be seen after synchronization.

NVTIFF_STATUS_NOT_INITIALIZED.doc: The library handle was not initialized.

NVTIFF_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER.doc: Wrong parameter was passed. For example, a null pointer as input data, or an invalid enum value.

NVTIFF_STATUS_BAD_TIFF.doc: Cannot parse the TIFF stream. Likely due to a corruption that cannot be handled.

NVTIFF_STATUS_TIFF_NOT_SUPPORTED.doc: Attempting to decode a TIFF stream that is not supported by the nvTIFF library.

NVTIFF_STATUS_ALLOCATOR_FAILURE.doc: The user-provided allocator functions returned a non-zero code.

NVTIFF_STATUS_EXECUTION_FAILED.doc: Error during the execution of the device tasks.

NVTIFF_STATUS_ARCH_MISMATCH.doc: The device capabilities are not enough for the set of input parameters provided.

NVTIFF_STATUS_INTERNAL_ERROR.doc: Unknown error occurred in the library.

NVTIFF_STATUS_NVCOMP_NOT_FOUND.doc: nvTIFF is unable to load the nvcomp library.

NVTIFF_STATUS_NVJPEG_NOT_FOUND.doc: nvTIFF is unable to load the nvjpeg library.

NVTIFF_STATUS_TAG_NOT_FOUND.doc: nvTIFF is unable to find information about the provided tag.

NVTIFF_STATUS_PARAMETER_OUT_OF_BOUNDS.doc: Provided parameter is outside the range of possible values.

NVTIFF_STATUS_NVJPEG2K_NOT_FOUND.doc: nvTIFF is unable to load the nvJPEG2000 library.

nvtiffEncoder_t.doc: Handle to opaque nvTIFF encoder instance.

nvtiffEncodeParams_t.doc: Handle to opaque nvTIFF encode parameters.

nvtiffDecoder_t.doc:
Handle to opaque nvTIFF decoder instance.

Stores intermediate decode buffers used in decoding.

nvtiffStream_t.doc:
Handle to opaque nvTIFF stream instance.

Used for parsing a TIFF file. TIFF metadata can be extracted using parser APIs.

nvtiffDecodeParams_t.doc:
Handle to opaque decode parameters.

Used to specify decode output parameters such as region of interest and output format.

NVTIFF_REGULAR_TIFF.doc: Standard TIFF format (up to 4GB file size).

nvtiffSampleFormat_t.doc:
Sample format types.

Corresponds to the SampleFormat (339) tag defined in the TIFF specification.

nvtiffPhotometricInt_t.doc:
Photometric interpretation types.

Corresponds to the PhotometricInterpretation (262) tag defined in the TIFF specification.

NVTIFF_PHOTOMETRIC_MINISWHITE.doc: 0 is white, max value is black.

NVTIFF_PHOTOMETRIC_MINISBLACK.doc: 0 is black, max value is white.

nvtiffPlanarConfig_t.doc:
Planar configuration types.

Corresponds to the PlanarConfiguration (284) tag defined in the TIFF specification.

nvtiffCompression_t.doc:
Compression types.

Corresponds to the Compression (259) tag defined in the TIFF specification.

nvtiffImageType.doc:
Image type flags.

Corresponds to the NewSubfileType (254) tag defined in the TIFF specification.

NVTIFF_IMAGETYPE_REDUCED_IMAGE.doc: Reduced resolution version of another image.

NVTIFF_IMAGETYPE_PAGE.doc: Single page of a multi-page image.

nvtiffImageInfo_t.doc:
TIFF image metadata structure.

Contains metadata of an image stored in a TIFF file.

image_type.doc: Image type flags from NewSubfileType tag.

bits_per_sample.doc: Bits per sample for each channel.

nvtiffImageGeometryType_t.doc:
Image geometry type.

Specifies whether a TIFF file uses strips or tiles.

nvtiffImageGeometry_t.doc:
Image geometry information.

Stores image geometry along with strip/tile dimensions. When the geometry type is [`nvtiffImageGeometryType_t::NVTIFF_IMAGE_STRIPED`], `strile_width` equals `image_width`.

nvtiffOutputFormat_t.doc:
Decode output format types.

Used to specify the decode output format.

NVTIFF_OUTPUT_RGB_I_UINT8.doc: Interleaved RGB with 8 bits per channel.

NVTIFF_OUTPUT_RGB_I_UINT16.doc: Interleaved RGB with 16 bits per channel.

nvtiffImage_t.doc:
Output image data structure.

Contains output image data buffers used by `nvtiffDecodeImageEx()`.

plane_data.doc: Array of pointers to plane data buffers on device.

plane_pitch_bytes.doc: Array of pitch values (bytes per row) for each plane.

num_planes.doc: Number of planes in the output image.

nvtiffTagDataType_t.doc: TIFF tag data types as defined in the TIFF specification.

nvtiffTag_t.doc:
TIFF tag identifiers.

Corresponds to various TIFF tags listed in the TIFF specification. Currently only GeoTIFF relevant tags are supported.

nvtiffGeoKey_t.doc:
GeoTIFF key identifiers.

Corresponds to various geo keys listed in the GeoTIFF specification. User can refer to the GeoTIFF specification for additional details.

nvtiffGeoKeyDataType_t.doc: Data type for GeoTIFF key values.
